gui.fourtwenty.machine.no_power: Needs BI, or a high player nearby.
gui.fourtwenty.terpinator.status.no_powe: Needs BI, or a high player nearby.
gui.fourtwenty.gauge.hookah: Made by this burn, sent down its Wicks
gui.fourtwenty.arrow.paused: Paused at %s%%. Needs BI, or a high player within 21 blocks. It keeps its place.
gui.fourtwenty.arrow.unlit: Not burning. Add a cured bud, a water bucket and charcoal, and it lights itself.
gui.fourtwenty.slot.rough: Rough Buds go here. Each slot holds one strain. A Transport Tube can fill it.
gui.fourtwenty.slot.trimmed: Trimmed Buds go here. Each slot holds one strain. A Transport Tube can fill it.
gui.fourtwenty.slot.trim_out: Trimmed Buds and any seeds land here. A Transport Tube carries it away. The machine stops if this fills up.
gui.fourtwenty.slot.cure_out: Cured Buds land here. A Transport Tube carries it away. The machine stops if this fills up.
gui.fourtwenty.slot.hookah_buds: Cured Buds or extracts go here, up to 64. Each burn uses one. Extracts burn longer.
gui.fourtwenty.slot.hookah_water: A water bucket goes here. It stays in, and the Hookah won’t burn without it.
gui.fourtwenty.slot.hookah_charcoal: Charcoal goes here, not regular coal. Each burn uses one.
gui.fourtwenty.help.trim:
Turns Rough Buds into Trimmed Buds, and sometimes gives a seed. Better strains give seeds less often.

PUT IN: Rough Buds on the left, or feed them with a hopper from the top or sides.

TAKE OUT: Trimmed Buds and seeds on the right, or put a hopper underneath.

POWER: Run Wicks from a Hookah or Stash of the same tier, or stand nearby high and it runs free. With neither, it pauses and keeps its place.

A higher-tier power source overloads it. It stops and smokes until you remove that source, and it never breaks.
gui.fourtwenty.help.cure:
Turns Trimmed Buds into Cured Buds, the ones you can smoke and craft with, a whole batch at a time.

PUT IN: Trimmed Buds on the left, or feed them with a hopper from the top or sides.

TAKE OUT: Cured Buds on the right, or put a hopper underneath.

POWER: Run Wicks from a Hookah or Stash of the same tier, or stand nearby high and it runs free. With neither, it pauses and keeps its place.

A higher-tier power source overloads it. It stops and smokes until you remove that source, and it never breaks.
gui.fourtwenty.help.hookah:
A shared smoke and a power source in one. It needs a Cured Bud, a water bucket and charcoal. Press Light to start a session.

Each burn lasts a minute and uses one bud and one charcoal. Extracts from a Rosin Rig burn from 2 to 15 minutes on the same charcoal. Anyone within 4 blocks gets the high.

POWER: While it burns it makes BI, enough to run four machines of its tier for that minute. Connect Wicks to send it out. It starts itself when something on its Wicks needs power, and only then.

A Hookah makes 4,200 BI a burn, a Double Hose 8,400 and a Big Bertha 16,800.
gui.fourtwenty.help.stash:
A battery. It stores spare BI and gives it out through Wicks at the same rate as a Hookah of its tier.

Connect it anywhere on a Wick line. Two Stashes on a line level out.

A source of a higher tier overloads it. It stops and smokes until you remove that source, and it never breaks. Stored BI is lost if you break the block.
gui.fourtwenty.help.hit_box:
Steps power between tiers, so a high-tier source can run lower-tier machines without overloading them.

The front face is the higher tier. Every other face is the tier below. Use the button to choose Toke to Puff, Rip to Toke or Blaze to Rip.

A face only takes power when something on the other side can use it.
gui.fourtwenty.help.terpinator:
Turns weed into terpenes.

1. Pick a colour you’ve caught at the Inspiration Infuser.
2. Add Cured Buds. Two buds make one vial.
3. Press Start.

Minecraft colours take any weed. Hemp colours need weed of their family.

POWER: It runs on BI through Wicks, or free with a high player within 21 blocks. With neither, it pauses and keeps its place.
gui.fourtwenty.help.infuser:
Smoking inspires colours. Here you mix resin into a pool until it matches a colour you’re inspired by, then catch it. Nothing is timed and nothing can fail.

The Infuse tab turns a Landrace seed and terpenes into a strain seed.

POWER: Catching a colour or infusing a seed costs BI through Wicks, or is free with a high player within 21 blocks. Without power it’s refused, and your pool is kept.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.rough_bud: Fresh off the plant. Trim it at a Trim Tray or trimming machine.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.trimmed_bud: Cure it on a Curing Rack or in a curing machine.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.weed_bud: Ready to smoke and craft with.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.trim_tray: Right-click with Rough Buds to trim one at a time. Needs no power. Sometimes gives a seed.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.curing_rack: Right-click with Trimmed Buds to hang up to 8. They cure in 5 minutes with no power. An empty hand takes them down.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.hemp_wick: Puff wire. Carries two Hookahs of BI. Any more burns it out.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.rolled_wick: Toke wire. Carries two Double Hoses of BI. Any more burns it out.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.glass_wick: Rip wire. Carries two Big Berthas of BI. Any more burns it out.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.weed_bong: A shared smoke and a Puff power source. Burns a Cured Bud and charcoal for a minute, making 4,200 BI.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.double_hose: An upgraded Hookah. Toke power: 8,400 BI a burn.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.big_bertha: A fully upgraded Hookah. Rip power: 16,800 BI a burn.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.hit_box: Steps power down a tier. The front face is the higher tier.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.snip_station: Tier 2 trimmer. Puff power. Takes Transport Tubes.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.bud_barber: Tier 3 trimmer. Toke power. Takes Transport Tubes.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.trim_reaper: Tier 4 trimmer. Rip power. Takes Transport Tubes.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.dry_box: Tier 2 curer. Puff power. Takes Transport Tubes.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.cure_closet: Tier 3 curer. Toke power. Takes Transport Tubes.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.the_humidor: Tier 4 curer. Rip power. Takes Transport Tubes.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.ash: What’s left of a burned-out Wick.
gui.fourtwenty.slot.study: This study needs %s of these. They’re used when the study starts.
gui.fourtwenty.help.plot:
A plot for any crop that grows on farmland. Right-click it with seeds to plant. It stays watered and grows the crop faster. Right-click with an empty hand opens this screen.

UPGRADE: Use the next tier’s plot on this one. The crop stays where it is.

POWER: From the Grow Tent up it runs on BI through Wicks, or free with a high player within 21 blocks. Without power the crop grows at normal speed and comes to no harm. Green sparkles show each boost. A lone crop takes about an hour on farmland, so even a boosted one takes a while.

The Aero Pod and Cosmic Kush Pod give half as many again of everything but seeds, and replant themselves.
gui.fourtwenty.help.think_tank:
Research with no colony.

1. Click a colour swatch to pick a study.
2. Load the items it asks for. They’re used when it starts.
3. Keep a crop growing on a Grow Op within 8 blocks. Better plots, and more of them, go faster.
4. Give it BI, or stay nearby high.
5. Press Collect when it’s done.

Studies always succeed. A bad batch only adds time, and it keeps its place if anything runs out.

A colour study counts as catching that colour at the Infuser.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.gold_wick: Blaze wire. Carries two Grand Hookahs of BI. Any more burns it out.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.grand_hookah: The biggest Hookah. Blaze power: 33,600 BI a burn.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.closet_grow: Grows crops 1.5 times as fast. Needs light, no power. Right-click with seeds to plant.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.grow_tent: Grows crops 2 times as fast, with its own lamp. Puff power. Right-click with seeds to plant.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.hydro_bed: Grows crops 3 times as fast, with no soil. Toke power. Right-click with seeds to plant.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.aero_pod: Grows crops 5 times as fast. Bigger harvests, and it replants itself. Rip power. Right-click with seeds to plant.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.cosmic_kush_pod: Grows crops 8 times as fast. Bigger harvests, and it replants itself. Copies a climate: right-click with sand, a snow block, a lily pad or a jungle sapling. Blaze power. Right-click with seeds to plant.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.think_tank: Research block. Pick a study, load it, and keep a crop growing on a Grow Op within 8 blocks.
gui.fourtwenty.hit_box.switch.tip: Switches between Toke to Puff, Rip to Toke and Blaze to Rip.
item.fourtwenty.weed_seeds.needs_plot: %s only grows on a %s or better
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.pheno_chamber: Crosses two seeds into a hybrid. Toke power. Takes Transport Tubes.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.pheno_lab: Breeds better traits into Double Crosses. Rip power. Takes Transport Tubes.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.pheno_cathedral: Breeds better traits into Ultras and Golden God. Blaze power. Takes Transport Tubes.
gui.fourtwenty.slot.parent: A seed goes here, one in each of these two slots. Each cross uses one of each. A Transport Tube can fill them.
gui.fourtwenty.slot.cross_out: The new seed lands here. A Transport Tube carries it away. The machine stops if both slots fill up.
gui.fourtwenty.help.pheno:
Crosses two seeds into one new seed.

PUT IN: a seed in each slot on the left. The right two strains make a Cross, and the screen shows which. Any other two give you one of the parents back.

CLIMATES: Landrace grown in a desert, snow, swamp or jungle sometimes gives a climate-touched seed. Put one in alone and it settles into that biome’s strain.

TRAITS: every seed has Potency, Yield and Length, rated 1 to 5. A new seed takes its parents’ average, then may move one up or down, so cross your best seeds to breed better ones.

ABOVE CROSSES: Double Crosses, Ultras and Golden God can’t be made here. Grow Double Cross parents side by side on good plots and a harvest will sometimes give the seed. A Buzz Bot makes it certain, and Ultras and Golden God need one.

TIERS: use a Pheno Lab to breed traits into Double Crosses, and a Pheno Cathedral for Ultras and Golden God.

POWER: the same as any machine: free if a high player is near, otherwise BI.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.buzz_bot: A robot bee. One Cured Bud runs it for an hour, and it runs free near a high player. It wanders within 16 blocks of weed and, every 5 minutes or so, pollinates ripe crops that can cross, for a guaranteed hybrid at the next harvest. It recharges at a nearby Stash. Out of power, it flies back to where you set it down and sleeps. Hit it to pack it up.
tooltip.fourtwenty.climate: Touched by the climate: %s. A Pheno Chamber can settle it.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.transport_tube: Connects machines, Hookahs and Terpinators. Any number can share a network, items run both ways at once, and output is shared out among everything that wants it. No tiers, no power. If a network runs into an unloaded chunk, its machines stop until it’s back.
gui.fourtwenty.hookah.light.tip: Start a session. It needs a bud, water and charcoal. It also starts itself whenever something on its Wicks needs power.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.rosin_rig: Refines Cured Buds into extracts that burn longer in a Hookah and hit harder in a pipe. Toke power. Takes Transport Tubes.
tooltip.fourtwenty.item.construction_joi: A crafting bench that makes twice as many hemp blocks, lamps, rugs and roads.
gui.fourtwenty.slot.rig_in: Cured Buds, Kief, Hash or Resin go here. A Transport Tube can fill it.
gui.fourtwenty.slot.rig_bottle: Glass Bottles go here. With one, Resin becomes Oil instead of Rosin.
gui.fourtwenty.slot.rig_out: Extracts land here. A Transport Tube carries them away. The machine stops if this fills up.
gui.fourtwenty.help.rig:
Refines weed into stronger stuff, one step at a time.

THE CHAIN: 1 Cured Bud makes 1 Kief. 2 Kief make 1 Hash. 1 Hash makes 1 Resin. 1 Resin makes 1 Rosin, or 1 Oil if there’s a Glass Bottle in the slot.

WHAT THEY DO: in a Hookah, one charcoal burns Kief for 2 minutes, Hash for 5, Resin for 7.5, and Rosin or Oil for 15. Biome strains burn half as long again. In a pipe, Hash and up smoke stronger and longer.

Extracts keep the strain and traits of the bud. No terpenes here: those come from the Terpinator.

POWER: the same as any machine: free if a high player is near, otherwise BI on Toke.
block.fourtwenty.curing_rack.status: Curing: next bud in about %s min.
block.fourtwenty.curing_rack.empty: Nothing hanging. Right-click with trimmed buds.
com.fourtwenty.building.dispensary.desc: The Budtender crafts the Dispensary menu (joints, then weed cookies, pipes and brownies as the Dispensary grows) and serves colonists and players in the shop.

com.minecolonies.coremod.gui.townhall.ha: Smoking a joint brings a small happiness benefit. Pending demand has a grace period; prolonged unmet demand slightly reduces happiness.

fourtwenty.dispensary.happiness.satisfie: I have had my dose and feel content. This gives a small happiness benefit until my next one is due.

fourtwenty.guide.title: Ask the Budtender
fourtwenty.guide.welcome.title: Welcome to the shop
fourtwenty.guide.welcome.text:
Pull up a stool. I run the Dispensary, and I know everything about FourTwenty, from seed to smoke.

Pick a topic to learn about growing weed, crafting joints, pipes, edibles and bongs, running a Dispensary, and how your colonists pick up the habit.

If something isn't working, the last page, Troubleshooting, has the usual fixes.
fourtwenty.guide.growing.title: Growing weed
fourtwenty.guide.growing.text:
§lFinding it§r
Wild weed grows in Plains, Savanna, Grove and Meadow biomes. Break it for seeds.

§lPlanting§r
Plant seeds on farmland. The crop grows through eight stages and likes the same conditions as wheat. Bone meal speeds it up.

§lHarvesting§r
• Breaking a young crop gives one seed back.
• A mature crop drops a seed and 1-3 Rough Buds. Right-clicking it harvests and replants.

§lTrimming§r
Right-click a Trim Tray with Rough Buds to snip them into Trimmed Buds. This is where seeds come from: about half the time for Landrace, rarer for better strains. The tooltip shows the chance.

§lCuring§r
Hang Trimmed Buds on a Curing Rack with a right-click. After 5 minutes they're Cured Buds, ready to smoke and craft with. Neither step needs power.

§lMachines§r
The Snip Station, Bud Barber and Trim Reaper trim, and the Dry Box, Cure Closet and The Humidor cure, faster at each tier. Hoppers feed the top and sides and empty the bottom. They run on BI through Wicks from a burning Hookah (upgrade it to a Double Hose, then a Big Bertha), or free with a high player within 21 blocks. A Wick carries two Hookahs of its tier and burns out past that. A block fed from a tier above its own overloads and stops until you fix it; it never breaks.

§lColony farms§r
MineColonies farmers know the crop and plant its seeds like any other. Their Rough Buds still need trimming and curing by you: a Dispensary only takes Cured Buds.
fourtwenty.guide.recipes.title: Recipes
fourtwenty.guide.recipes.text:
§lWeed Joint§r
2 paper and 1 bud along the bottom row.

§lWeed Pipe§r
4 uses. A bud top-right, charcoal below it, and oak, birch and spruce planks along the bottom.

§lWeed Cookie§r
A cookie and a bud, anywhere in the grid.

§lWeed Brownie§r
A bud in the middle, surrounded by 4 cocoa beans and 4 wheat.

§lGlass Bong§r
4 glass and a water bucket (you get the bucket back).

§lHookah§r
6 dark oak planks, 2 glass and a gold ingot.

§lDispensary hut§r
Planks along the top and bottom, paper, bud, paper across the middle.

§lLamps§r
See the Lamps page.
fourtwenty.guide.smoking.title: Joints and pipes
fourtwenty.guide.smoking.text:
Hold right-click to smoke. A joint is used up; a pipe lasts 4 smokes.

§lThe high§r
• Regeneration II for 30 seconds
• Night Vision for 2 minutes
• Luck for 90 seconds
• The munchies: Hunger II for 10 seconds
• A 30% chance of 20 seconds of Nausea

Colonists within 4 blocks breathe the smoke too. For a first-timer, that counts as trying weed.
fourtwenty.guide.edibles.title: Cookies and brownies
fourtwenty.guide.edibles.text:
Edibles are food, but they take a while to kick in.

§lWeed Cookie§r
Kicks in after 10 seconds and lasts about 3 minutes: Regeneration, Night Vision, Luck and the munchies.

§lWeed Brownie§r
Kicks in after 15 seconds and lasts about 5 minutes. Stronger, and adds Speed and Jump Boost.

§lGood to know§r
• You can't eat another until the first one kicks in.
• Logging out or dying before then cancels it.
• Colonists never eat edibles as food, and restaurants won't serve them. Edibles only come from me.
fourtwenty.guide.bong.title: The glass bong
fourtwenty.guide.bong.text:
Place a bong anywhere; it turns its bowl toward you.

Right-click it with a Weed Bud anywhere in your inventory to take a hit. Each hit uses one bud and gives the same high as a pipe, with bubbles and smoke. There's a 5-second cooldown between hits.

Colonists within 4 blocks get secondhand smoke.

Upgrade a glass bong into a specialty bong for an all-day buff (next page).
fourtwenty.guide.specialty.title: Specialty bongs
fourtwenty.guide.specialty.text:
Craft a glass bong with two ingredients. A hit gives the normal high plus a buff that lasts a whole Minecraft day.

§lJackrabbit§r: rabbit's foot, sugar
Speed II, Jump Boost II

§lDeep Sea§r: prismarine crystals, nautilus shell
Water Breathing, Dolphin's Grace, Conduit Power

§lForge§r: blaze rod, magma cream
Fire Resistance, Strength

§lOwl§r: golden carrot, spyglass
Night Vision, Haste II

§lSage§r: amethyst shard, book
Luck II, Hero of the Village

§lPhantom§r: phantom membrane, feather
Flight for the whole day, even through relogs and death, then a few seconds of Slow Falling.

§lFor colonists§r
Put specialty bongs inside the Dispensary. Smokers from level 5 homes take their session at the bong that suits their job and get +5 to its two skills for a day, or +10 if one is their job's main skill. Each session costs a bud from the shop.
fourtwenty.guide.hookah.title: The hookah
fourtwenty.guide.hookah.text:
Right-click the hookah to open it. It has three slots: buds (up to 4), a water bucket, and charcoal.

It lights by itself: each burn uses one bud and one charcoal and lasts a minute. The water stays.

§lPower§r
A burn makes 4,200 BI on a Hookah, 8,400 on a Double Hose and 16,800 on a Big Bertha: enough to run four machines of its tier for the minute.

§lWhile it burns§r
Players within 4 blocks get a mellow high. Colonists within 6 blocks get a Hookah session happiness bonus that lingers 5 minutes, and first-timers count as having tried weed.

I look after the hookah nearest my counter: I add water and fuel, and add buds when there are customers. Hoppers can fill all three slots.
fourtwenty.guide.dispensary.title: The Dispensary
fourtwenty.guide.dispensary.text:
The Dispensary is my shop. Craft the hut, then place it with the Build Tool from the FourTwenty or Sensi Heights pack.

§lLevels§r
1. A wooden shop: joints, 6 seats
2. A stone shop: adds cookies
3. A modern storefront: adds pipes
4. A deeper store with display cases and a lounge: adds brownies, 9 seats
5. A rooftop lounge: 17 more seats outside (nobody sits up there in the rain)

§lSpace§r
Every level fits the same 11 by 24 area, 11 blocks tall, with the hut in the same spot. Leave the block above the hut clear: the hut is a two-block counter.

Hire one Budtender (that's me) to run it.
fourtwenty.guide.budtender.title: What I do all day
fourtwenty.guide.budtender.text:
§lI craft§r
Joints from paper and buds, plus cookies, pipes and brownies as the shop levels up. I make one small batch at a time of whatever is lowest (8 joints, 4 cookies or brownies, or 2 pipes), so there's always some of everything.

§lI keep a bud reserve§r
I never craft my last few raw buds (4 at level 1, up to 16 at level 5). They're for bong sessions and the hookah.

§lI order supplies§r
Keep buds, paper and the other ingredients in your warehouse. Couriers bring me what I request.

§lI serve§r
I walk over to customers anywhere in the shop.

The hut's Dispensary service tab shows my stock and anything I'm missing.
fourtwenty.guide.customers.title: Serving colonists
fourtwenty.guide.customers.text:
Adults with a finished home can develop a habit, but only after they've tried weed once (next page). Children never do.

When they're due, colonists use anything they carry first. Otherwise they come to the shop, wait anywhere inside, and I serve them. If I can't, they help themselves after 20 seconds.

§lWhat they get depends on their home§r
• Levels 1-2: one at the shop
• Levels 3-4: a pipe (4 uses) or 4 edibles to take home
• Level 5: one at the shop and a pipe to take home

They take the best I have: brownie, then pipe, then cookie, then joint. With nothing to take home, they have one here and complain.

Hunger, illness, sleep, fights and raids come first.
fourtwenty.guide.affinity.title: Habits and tolerance
fourtwenty.guide.affinity.text:
§lFirst time§r
A colonist's first exposure decides their habit: a dose, secondhand smoke within 4 blocks, or sitting by a lit hookah. Until then they show as "never tried it".

§lType§r
• Not interested (20%)
• Smoker (35%)
• Edibles only (20%)
• Both (25%)

§lHow often§r
From every 4 days up to four times a day. Most start at daily.

§lDrift§r
Each dose, and the first hookah session each day, has a 10% chance to change it one step, usually up (75%).

§lTolerance break§r
Pushed past four times a day, a colonist takes a two-day break, a little grumpy and with no cravings, then goes back to how they started.

Hover the cannabis line on a colonist's happiness tab to see their type and frequency.
fourtwenty.guide.benefits.title: Why it's worth it
fourtwenty.guide.benefits.text:
A satisfied colonist gets one extra heart of maximum health and a small happiness boost for a Minecraft day. Another dose refreshes it; it doesn't stack or heal on its own.

If a craving goes unmet for another day, they get a small happiness penalty. Colonists who just became eligible get a day's grace first.

Picking something up isn't enough; they have to actually use it.
fourtwenty.guide.buying.title: Buying for yourself
fourtwenty.guide.buying.text:
Inside the shop, right-click me while holding an emerald to see the menu, then click what you want.

§lPrices§r
• Joint: 1 emerald
• Weed Cookie: 1 emerald
• Weed Brownie: 2 emeralds
• Pipe: 3 emeralds

Colony members with hut permission get it free. Emeralds go into the shop's storage.

The menu grows with the shop: joints from level 1, cookies from 2, pipes from 3 and brownies from 4. Items show as sold out until I have them.
fourtwenty.guide.lamps.title: Lamps
fourtwenty.guide.lamps.text:
Coloured lamps in all 16 dye colours, no other mod needed.

§lLamp§r
Lights when powered by redstone. 3 glass, a bud and the dye make 4.

§lInverted Lamp§r
Always on unless powered. Craft a lamp with a joint.

§lLamp Trim§r
A thin, always-lit plate that sticks to the face you click. One lamp makes 4.

Lit lamps glow with a soft coloured halo, even in your hand.
fourtwenty.guide.sensi_heights.title: Sensi Heights
fourtwenty.guide.sensi_heights.text:
"A hillside town that grows around the grow." Sensi Heights is a MineColonies style that comes with FourTwenty. Choose it in the Build Tool with Switch Pack.

§lSo far§r
• Supply camp: stocked racks and weed seeds. It's also Workshop level 1.
• Workshop, levels 1-5
• Residence, levels 1-5
• Builder's Hut, levels 1-2 so far
• Dispensary, levels 1-5

More buildings are on the way. A few use a Farmer's Delight cutting board, which is just left out without that mod.
fourtwenty.guide.faq.title: Troubleshooting
fourtwenty.guide.faq.text:
§lI'm not crafting§r
I need buds and paper (and the other ingredients for higher levels) in the warehouse, and room in the hut's storage. Check the Dispensary service tab.

§lNobody comes in§r
Colonists need a finished home and a first try. Light a hookah near them or smoke by them. Someone who's "not interested" never will.

§lCustomers complain§r
I had nothing for them to take home. Keep pipes or edibles in stock.

§lThe hookah won't light§r
It needs water, fuel and a bud. I only tend the one nearest my counter.

§lNo specialty bong session§r
Only smokers from level 5 homes use them, and the bong has to be inside the Dispensary.

§lCan't eat an edible§r
Your last one hasn't kicked in yet.

§lServer admins§r
/fourtwenty status shows a colonist's habit; the other /fourtwenty commands help set up tests.

terpene.fourtwenty.resin.line: Two buds walk into a press. One resin walks out.
terpene.fourtwenty.pin.line: Smells like a forest that knows things.
terpene.fourtwenty.myr_myr_lim.line: Return to being the uncarved block.
terpene.fourtwenty.myr_myr_pin.line: It is not enough to have a good mind; the main thing is to use it well.
terpene.fourtwenty.myr_myr_lav.line: All of man's unhappiness comes from one thing: not knowing how to remain quietly in a room.
terpene.fourtwenty.myr_myr_myr.line: By an epiphany he meant a sudden spiritual manifestation.
terpene.fourtwenty.myr_lim_lim.line: Water, water, every where, / Nor any drop to drink.
terpene.fourtwenty.myr_lim_pin.line: If the human brain were so simple that we could understand it, we would be so simple that we couldn't.
terpene.fourtwenty.myr_lim_lav.line: A mote of dust suspended in a sunbeam.
terpene.fourtwenty.myr_lim_myr.line: An ever-living fire, kindling in measures and going out in measures.
terpene.fourtwenty.myr_pin_lim.line: Let us then suppose the mind to be, as we say, white paper, void of all characters.
terpene.fourtwenty.myr_pin_pin.line: When philosophy paints its grey in grey, then has a shape of life grown old.
terpene.fourtwenty.myr_pin_lav.line: Avoiding both these extremes, the Tathagata has realized the Middle Way.
terpene.fourtwenty.myr_pin_myr.line: I never can catch myself at any time without a perception.
terpene.fourtwenty.myr_lav_lim.line: Just as our soul, being air, holds us together, so do breath and air encompass the whole world.
terpene.fourtwenty.myr_lav_pin.line: The fog comes / on little cat feet.
terpene.fourtwenty.myr_lav_lav.line: Morning is when I am awake and there is a dawn in me.
terpene.fourtwenty.myr_lav_myr.line: When you gaze long into an abyss, the abyss also gazes into you.
terpene.fourtwenty.lim_myr_lim.line: I've often seen a cat without a grin, but a grin without a cat!
terpene.fourtwenty.lim_myr_pin.line: I can resist everything except temptation.
terpene.fourtwenty.lim_myr_lav.line: The smell and taste of things remain poised a long time, like souls.
terpene.fourtwenty.lim_myr_myr.line: Nothing is lost, nothing is created, everything is transformed.
terpene.fourtwenty.lim_lim_lim.line: Try again. Fail again. Fail better.
terpene.fourtwenty.lim_lim_pin.line: Philosophy is written in this grand book, the universe.
terpene.fourtwenty.lim_lim_myr.line: Those who seek gold dig up much earth and find little.
terpene.fourtwenty.lim_pin_lim.line: Blushing is the most peculiar and the most human of all expressions.
terpene.fourtwenty.lim_pin_pin.line: Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow.
terpene.fourtwenty.lim_pin_lav.line: The eye through which I see God is the same eye through which God sees me.
terpene.fourtwenty.lim_pin_myr.line: The heart has its reasons which reason knows nothing of.
terpene.fourtwenty.lim_lav_lim.line: Once Zhuang Zhou dreamt he was a butterfly, fluttering about, happy with himself.
terpene.fourtwenty.lim_lav_pin.line: The way up and the way down are one and the same.
terpene.fourtwenty.pin_myr_lim.line: For in that sleep of death what dreams may come… must give us pause.
terpene.fourtwenty.pin_myr_pin.line: And, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf.
terpene.fourtwenty.pin_myr_lav.line: One resists the invasion of armies; one does not resist the invasion of ideas.
terpene.fourtwenty.pin_myr_myr.line: Water is the first principle of all things.
terpene.fourtwenty.pin_lim_lim.line: A riddle, wrapped in a mystery, inside an enigma; but perhaps there is a key.
terpene.fourtwenty.pin_lim_pin.line: Grey, dear friend, is all theory, and green the golden tree of life.
terpene.fourtwenty.pin_lim_myr.line: Faith is the highest passion in a man.
terpene.fourtwenty.pin_pin_lim.line: Such as are thy habitual thoughts, such also will be the character of thy mind; for the soul is dyed by the thoughts.
terpene.fourtwenty.pin_pin_pin.line: Rough winds do shake the darling buds of May.
terpene.fourtwenty.pin_pin_lav.line: Adopt the pace of nature: her secret is patience.
terpene.fourtwenty.pin_pin_myr.line: Out of all things one, and out of one all things.
terpene.fourtwenty.pin_lav_lim.line: Like a boy playing on the sea-shore, whilst the great ocean of truth lay all undiscovered before me.
terpene.fourtwenty.pin_lav_lav.line: What then is time? If no one asks me, I know.
terpene.fourtwenty.pin_lav_myr.line: You would not find out the boundaries of soul, so deep a measure does it have.
terpene.fourtwenty.lav_myr_lim.line: Let every truth be false which was not greeted with a laugh!
terpene.fourtwenty.lav_myr_pin.line: When we are, death is not come, and when death is come, we are not.
terpene.fourtwenty.lav_myr_lav.line: Even sleepers are workers in what goes on in the universe.
terpene.fourtwenty.lav_myr_myr.line: The starry heavens above me and the moral law within me.
terpene.fourtwenty.lav_lim_pin.line: Or in the night, imagining some fear, / How easy is a bush supposed a bear!
terpene.fourtwenty.lav_lim_lav.line: Man is the measure of all things.
terpene.fourtwenty.lav_lim_myr.line: The whole universe is in a glass of wine.
terpene.fourtwenty.lav_pin_lim.line: We love to contemplate blue, not because it advances to us, but because it draws us after it.
terpene.fourtwenty.lav_pin_pin.line: Thought and being are the same.
terpene.fourtwenty.lav_pin_lav.line: I wish I had invented blue jeans.
terpene.fourtwenty.lav_pin_myr.line: Upon those who step into the same rivers, different and again different waters flow.
terpene.fourtwenty.lav_lav_lim.line: The eternal silence of these infinite spaces frightens me.
terpene.fourtwenty.lav_lav_pin.line: In everything there is a portion of everything.
terpene.fourtwenty.lav_lav_lav.line: Man is but a reed, the most feeble thing in nature; but he is a thinking reed.
terpene.fourtwenty.lav_lav_myr.line: Thoughts without content are empty, intuitions without concepts are blind.

terpene.fourtwenty.mc_white.line: Sprinkle it on anything and watch it grow. Ideas included.
terpene.fourtwenty.mc_orange.line: Warm all the way down. Mind the fireballs.
terpene.fourtwenty.mc_magenta.line: Pom-poms on a stick, cheering you on.
terpene.fourtwenty.mc_light_blue.line: One tree, one block, endless sky.
terpene.fourtwenty.mc_yellow.line: Nine of these make an ingot. None of these make sense.
terpene.fourtwenty.mc_lime.line: Bouncy, sticky, and it splits into smaller thoughts.
terpene.fourtwenty.mc_pink.line: A one in six hundred chance. You beat the odds today.
terpene.fourtwenty.mc_gray.line: Every great build starts with a pile of these.
terpene.fourtwenty.mc_light_gray.line: Falls the moment nothing holds it up. Relatable.
terpene.fourtwenty.mc_cyan.line: Never dig straight down for this one. / (You will anyway.)
terpene.fourtwenty.mc_purple.line: Stand still long enough and it takes you somewhere.
terpene.fourtwenty.mc_brown.line: The first block you ever punched still thinks about you.
terpene.fourtwenty.mc_green.line: That's a very nice house you've built. / Ssssss...
terpene.fourtwenty.mc_red.line: Every wire in your head lights up at once.
terpene.fourtwenty.mc_black.line: Takes forever to get up. Worth it.
